paper_id: Wang et al. - 2012 - Energy-Efficient Reverse Skyline Query Processing over Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Energy-Efficient Reverse Skyline Query Processing over Wireless Sensor Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
motivation: 无线传感器节点电池电量有限,现有不考虑能效的中心化方法无法直接应用于分布式传感环境
problem_framing: 逆Skyline查询是不可分解的,无法直接利用网络内聚合技术降低通信开销
key_insight: 通过引入full dominance使查询可分解,再以2-full-skyband过滤假阳性,使RS查询能在WSN中高效执行
method_signature: 基于full skyband的能效逆Skyline查询处理,转换为可分解算子进行网络内处理
evaluation_criteria: 通信开销(消息数量和传输数据量)作为能效主要衡量指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 2-full-skyband结果集大于full skyline,存在一定冗余
evidence_for_taste: cannot be used in WSNs to answer RS queries
if we can reduce the amount of communication
we propose a novel concept, called semidominance
Interestingly, we prove that the full skyline query is decomposable
the set of reverse skyline points is a subset of full skylines
thinking_moves: 将不可分解的查询问题重新形式化为可分解的替代问题
通过引入新的支配关系概念(full dominance)建立传递性
先证明集合包含关系(RS⊆FS),再分析为何不相等
识别假阳性的根本原因(full-dominated points不在结果集中)
迭代收紧搜索空间: skyline→skyband→marked full skyline
理论证明与工程验证相结合
